pokedexEntries.sw: When this Pokémon sounds as if it’s strumming a guitar, it’s actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

pokedexEntries.sh: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.

pokedexEntries.sc: As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity, a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar reverberates through the surrounding area.

pokedexEntries.vi: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

pokedexEntries.za: When Toxtricity claws at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity, a sound like that of a guitar echoes through the air.
